basic_details.short_information: Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL), a Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence at Vaddem, Vasco-da-Gama, Goa, is filling 40 posts under GSL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 06/2026). Of these, 31 are regular posts in pay grades E-0 to E-8 (IDA-2017). The other 9 are fixed term posts for 03 years, which may be extended up to 02 years. Indian Nationals can apply online through www.goashipyard.in from 00.00 hrs on 23 October 2026 to 17.00 hrs on 22 November 2026. The printout of the online form, with hard copies of the relevant documents, must reach GSL on or before 2 December 2026.

how_to_apply: GSL accepts applications only through its online application system, followed by a hard copy sent by post. Online applications open at 00.00 hrs on 23 October 2026 and close at 17.00 hrs on 22 November 2026.
Visit www.goashipyard.in. Under the link Notice Board- 'Careers', click the link 'GSL Careers'.
Click the 'Apply Online' button and select the post you wish to apply for.
Complete the personal information in the online application form, then fill in the payment details.

Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online through SBI e-pay (debit card/ credit card/ net banking etc.). Wait for the intimation from the server and do not press back or refresh, to avoid double charges.
Download and print the "Fee receipt" generated on successful payment. If no fee receipt is generated, the payment has failed: log in again and repeat the payment.
SUBMIT the application form. Without this step the form is treated as incomplete, and it cannot be edited after the online application is completed.

Take two printouts of the system-generated online application form. Send one, with all relevant documents, to: General Manager (HR&A), HR&A Department, Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802. Keep the second copy for future reference.
The printout and hard copies of the relevant documents must reach GSL on or before 2 December 2026.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, with the prescribed fee, for each post. For difficulty applying online, contact [email protected].

Applications without the prescribed fee are liable to be rejected. The candidature of applicants who pay less than the prescribed fee, or pay by any other method, will be rejected. Fees paid by ineligible candidates are forfeited, and no correspondence will be entertained about them.
Keep scanned copies (preferably JPG/PDF) of these documents ready before filling in the online application:
Passport size colour photograph with a light background (preferably white), with nothing covering the face and eyes, below 450 KB.
Signature in black ink on plain white paper, below 450 KB. It must be a scan of your own pen signature, not a digital signature.
SSC certificate as proof of date of birth, not more than 500 KB.
Educational qualification mark sheet & degree, not more than 1 MB.
Caste Certificate, not more than 500 KB.
Experience Certificates, not more than 1 MB.
Aadhaar Card, not more than 500 KB.

content_sections.heading: About GSL
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited (shipbuilders, shiprepairers and engineers) is a Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence. It is a Schedule 'A' Mini Ratna Category-I company at Vaddem, Vasco-da-Gama, Goa – 403 802. GSL designs and builds ships for the Indian Navy, the Indian Coast Guard and other customers, including friendly foreign countries. The notice describes it as an ISO 9001-2015, 14001:2015 and 45001:2018 certified company.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 40 vacancies: 31 regular employment posts (Part A) and 9 fixed term employment posts (Part B). The vacancies include backlog reserved vacancies. For post 2, GSL reserves the right to offer a grade lower than the one applied for: candidates who apply for Additional General Manager (AGM) may be considered for the Deputy General Manager grade, as per suitability. The post-wise details give 01 vacancy each for Chief General Manager (Business Development)/ General Manager (Business Development) and Chief General Manager (Technical)/ General Manager (Technical). For these two posts (Sl. No. 2 and 3), GSL reserves the right to offer a lower grade: candidates who apply for Chief General Manager (CGM) may be considered for the General Manager grade, as per suitability. In the post-wise details, "SR" stands for Ship Repairs. Abbreviations: UR = Unreserved; SC = Scheduled Caste; ST = Scheduled Tribe; OBC(NCL) = Other Backward Class (Non Creamy Layer); EWS = Economically Weaker Section; PwBD = Persons with Bench Mark Disabilities; HH = Hard of Hearing. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: GSL invites applications from Indian Nationals. Each post has its own essential qualification, desirable qualification, essential work experience and desirable experience, given below in the notice's order. The upper age limit and experience are counted as on 30.09.2026. Essential Qualification: Graduate AND qualified Chartered Accountant from Institute of Chartered Accountants of India / Qualified Cost Accountant from Institute of Cost Accountants of India. Desirable Qualification: M.B.A in finance from universities/ AICTE approved institution. Essential Work Experience: Minimum 23 years of post-qualification relevant work experience in finalizing the annual accounts in compliance with all statutory requirements, vetting of procurement & financial proposals, and treasury management that includes investment of surplus funds. The experience should also cover price negotiations accounts, liaison with financial institutions for fund based/non-fund based facilities, pay roll, Forex management, co-ordination of internal audit, dealing with various auditors, Taxation and MIS (EDP & ERP). Desirable Experience: Familiarity with or knowledge of Government rules and regulations as applicable to CPSEs. Experience in Financial Institutions/ NBFCs/ Public Sector Organizations/ Joint ventures of PSEs/ Central Govt/ State Govt/ Autonomous body/ Private Sector. Essential Educational Qualification: Full time regular Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) / Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech.) in Naval Architecture from a recognized University /AICTE approved institution. Desirable Qualification: Post Graduate Degree in relevant field or a post graduate diploma in Project Management. Essential Work Experience: Minimum 16 years for Additional General Manager and 13 years for Deputy General Manager of post-qualification relevant work experience in designing and analyzing the drawings, technical specification formulation, and executing production design of ship structures & hull forms. Experience of working on advanced ship design platforms such as AVEVA Marine/ Tribon, NAPA, AutoCAD and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Software. Desirable Experience: Knowledge of global Classification Society Rules (e.g. IRS, ABS, DNV, LRS) along with statutory regulations, and awareness about the latest developments in shipbuilding technology, designs and product innovations. Essential Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline with 2 years full time Regular MBA / MSW / PG Degree / Diploma from a recognized University / AICTE approved institution with specialization in HRM / IR / Personnel Management / Labour and Social Welfare / Labour Studies / Social Work. Desirable Qualification: Graduate in Engineering with Degree /Diploma course in Labour Laws or LL.B /B.L. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice gives each grade's pay scale together with an approximate CTC. Where two CTC figures are printed, the second is for Fixed Term Employment (FTE) posts. Other benefits such as Performance Related Pay, Accident Insurance Coverage, a Contributory Medical Insurance Policy and Welfare items will apply as per Company Rules. Posts A (1 to 18) are Regular Employment Posts. Posts B (1 to 6) are purely Fixed Term Employment, initially for 03 years. This term may be extended by up to 2 years at most, depending on the organisation's requirement and the individual's performance. A fixed term post is NOT against a regular post: the employment ends automatically at the end of the term unless the candidate is told otherwise in writing. GSL does not give any assurance of regular employment after the fixed term ends.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for all posts except the Junior Manager posts will be through an interview only. For the Junior Manager posts there is a written test and an interview. Management reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility criteria for shortlisting if there is a large response. It also reserves the right to decide the criteria for screening and shortlisting applications. The written test carries 85 marks and the interview 15 marks. Candidates who score 50% or above in the written test (UR & EWS), or 45% or above (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD, when the post is reserved), will be shortlisted for document verification followed by the interview. The qualifying marks for the interview are 50% or above for UR & EWS and 45% or above for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD (when the post is reserved). Among the candidates who qualify in the interview, selection is by merit on the overall aggregate of written test and interview marks, following the reservation guidelines. A tie is decided by seniority in age. Call letters will be sent only by e-mail to the registered e-mail ID of shortlisted candidates. GSL is not responsible for non-receipt of e-mail or loss of a candidate's e-mail ID and password. Outstation candidates who qualify for the interview will be paid travelling allowance by the shortest route from their residence (as registered in the Online Application System) to Goa Shipyard Limited. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Advt. No. 06/2026 lists 40 vacancies: 31 regular employment posts and 9 fixed term employment posts, spread across 24 posts from Junior Manager to Chief General Manager.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes at 17.00 hrs on 22 November 2026. The printout of the online form, with hard copies of the relevant documents, must reach Goa Shipyard Limited on or before 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the GSL Deputy Manager (Technical) post?
faq.answer: Deputy Manager (Technical) needs a full time regular B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical / Production/ Industrial/ Marine Engineering from a recognised University / AICTE approved Institution. The candidate also needs a minimum of 4 years of post-qualification work experience in the Shipbuilding/Ship repair industry.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies by post and category and is counted as on 30.09.2026. For example, Deputy Manager posts (regular) are UR/EWS-33, OBC(NCL)-36 and SC/ST-38, Junior Manager posts are UR-40, and Chief General Manager (Finance) is UR-54.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs.30000-3%-120000 (E-0) for Junior Manager to Rs.120000-3%-280000 (E-8) for Chief General Manager (IDA-2017). The approximate CTC is Rs. 10.01 lakh to Rs. 40.28 lakh, and for E-2 (Deputy Manager) it is Rs. 16.62 lakh (Rs. 15.36 lakh for FTE).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- (Non-Refundable), paid online through SBI e-pay. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted, and internal candidates pay no fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at www.goashipyard.in through Notice Board- 'Careers', then 'GSL Careers' and 'Apply Online'. Then send one printout of the form, with the relevant documents, to General Manager (HR&A), HR&A Department, Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All posts except Junior Manager are filled through an interview only. Junior Manager candidates take a written test of 85 marks and an interview of 15 marks, and selection is on the combined merit of both.

faq.question: Q9. Are the GSL fixed term posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The six Part B posts are fixed term employment, initially for 03 years and extendable by up to 2 years, and are not against a regular post. GSL gives no assurance of regular employment after the term ends.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post in GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, with the prescribed application fee, for each post.
